title: Have an approved drinking water quality management plan
what: As a drinking water service provider, carry out a drinking water service only under an approved drinking water quality management plan, and comply with it.

sources.title: Water Supply (Safety and Reliability) Act 2008 (Qld)
sources.quote: A drinking water service provider must not carry out a drinking water service unless there is an approved drinking water quality management plan for the drinking water service
